HomeIframe.title: Doodle Champion Island Games
HomeIframe.description: The Doodle Champion Island Games is a 2021 interactive browser game developed by Google in collaboration with Studio 4°C.

HomeFeatures.whatIsTitle: What is Doodle Champion Island Games?
HomeFeatures.whatIsDescription: Doodle Champion Island Games is an online role-playing browser game released in July 2021 to celebrate the 2020 Summer Olympics and Paralympics. Play now!
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep3: Join a team and earn points.
HomeFeatures.feature1Description: Discover seven distinct regions, each with its own unique challenges.
HomeFeatures.feature2Description: Participate in archery, swimming, skateboarding, and more.
HomeFeatures.feature3Description: Choose from red, blue, green, or yellow and compete for points.
HomeFeatures.feature4Description: Enjoy beautiful cutscenes created by Studio 4°C.
